race.comment: SPOOK CROCKER (7) ran second last start at Mt Gambier over 1780m, beaten 30 metres. Tactics will be crucial from this wide draw. Facing a tougher assignment but he is up to the task. MAJOR ROY (4) is worth plenty of thought off a last-start win by 1.5 metres at Ararat over 2195m. OCEAN AVENUE (1) has place prospects after his last-start fourth over 1780m at Mt Gambier on November 18.
